args.sql:
CREATE VIEW view_premium_quality_scans AS
SELECT
    s.questregistry AS scan_id,
    p.arcregistry AS project,
    si.zonelabel AS site,
    s.chronotag AS timestamp,
    spc.scanresolmm AS resolution,
    spc.pointdense AS density,
    spc.coverpct AS coverage,
    spc.lappct AS overlap,
    spc.noisedb AS noise_level
FROM
    scans s
JOIN
    projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
JOIN
    sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
JOIN
    scanpointcloud spc ON s.arcref = spc.arcref
JOIN
    scanqc sq ON s.arcref = sq.arcref
WHERE
    sq.valistate = 'Approved'
    AND sq.archstat = 'Verified'
    AND spc.noisedb < 1.5;
